result.rationale: The diff changes the check to `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []; if (evt.location === MeetLocationType && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar")` with no optional chaining on mainHostDestinationCalendar, while the old code used `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`. handleNewBooking in this diff sets `destinationCalendar: ... : null` when both eventType and organizer destination calendars are absent, so mainHostDestinationCalendar can be undefined and the dereference throws a TypeError.

judged_text: The rewritten Meet-location check dereferences mainHostDestinationCalendar without optional chaining, so a booking with location integrations:google-video and no destination calendar crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration'). Any booking where eventType.destinationCalendar and organizerUser.destinationCalendar are both absent (handleNewBooking sets destinationCalendar to null in exactly that case, per its own ternary) and the location is Google Meet throws a 500 at EventManager.create instead of the previous behavior of falling back to Cal Video; the old code's `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` tolerated the null.
